facts.business: Diamant Infrastructure Limited is an infrastructure and construction company focused on road construction and real estate, currently non-operational with no active projects.

auditor.name: R. A. GUPTA & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The company has no major business transactions and no employees, casting significant uncertainty on its ability to continue as a going concern. The company has prepared financial statements on a going concern basis based on management's representation that the situation is temporary. Key Audit Matter: Loan classified as NPA with company premises given as collateral security; bank has taken possession and company has vacated the property.

key_risks: Challenges associated with restarting business operations
Highly competitive infrastructure sector requiring adequate financial resources and technical capabilities
Changes in Government policies and regulatory requirements
Fluctuations in material and financing costs
Going concern uncertainty due to non-operational status
